ryan: FYI we're deploying search-service v3.2.0 in the 08:00 PT window. Feature flag `ff_typeahead_opt` will be enabled gradually: 8% -> 40% -> 100%. Model routing pinned to prod-v1.10 for 50m.

deploy-bot: Start 2024-08-05T08:00:00PT. Canary=8 instances. Schedule: 8% @t+3m, 40% @t+10m, 100% @t+22m. Auto-pause conditions set (p99>220ms for 4m OR 5xx>0.6% sustained 4m). Posting health at each step.

olga: Add cache-hit ratio gate: if downstream cache hit falls >6% pause. Also please include a one-liner rollback cmd in thread.

netops: I'll watch infra and routing. If pause fires I can pin routing and open a fast maintenance banner for clients.

deploy-bot: Rollback snippet:
```
redwoodctl ff set ff_typeahead_opt 0 --reason "rollback: safety gate"
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v1.10 --duration 50m
```

ryan: Runbook updated: pause -> collect traces -> notify #incidents -> decision within 12m. Docs link: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.2.0

deploy-bot: Canary stable at 8% @t+5m. Moving to 40% now.

olga: brief p95 spike at t+9m, returned baseline by t+11m. No action.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% @t+23m. Final: model routing pinned for 50m. Handing monitoring to oncall.
